_doc: Keys and value types of Codex hook payloads for SUBAGENT activity, from three real `codex exec` runs
(codex-cli 0.160.1, 2026-10-13, default model, capture hook registered with matcher `.*` for every event
Codex supports, next to the shoal guard).  Shapes only; no prompt text, file contents or real ids.
docs/specs/guard-every-gate/SPEC.md S0 / E0.  Run A = applier (apply_patch then shell), B = built-in worker
(shell, apply_patch, shell), C = spawn of a role that does not exist.

tool_response.note: no agent_id, no agent_type in the response

main_spawn_post_failure.note: unknown agent_type: PreToolUse fired, PostToolUse did NOT fire, no SubagentStart; the spawn tool returned an error string `unknown agent_type '<name>'` (seen only in the session rollout function_call_output, plain str)

equalities.subagent_turn_id_note: the subagent has its own turn_id, constant across its SubagentStart, tool calls and SubagentStop; the main's spawn/wait events keep the main turn_id
equalities.ordering_seen: spawn Pre, spawn Post, SubagentStart, (main wait Pre), subagent tool Pre/Post..., SubagentStop, wait Post, Stop

guard_observations.run_A_applier: prompt state; tool collaborationspawn_agent rule=dispatch decision=allow; Stop rule=STOP decision=block reason=unverified_change (main then ran one read-only Bash check, second Stop passed)
guard_observations.run_B_worker: prompt state; collaborationspawn_agent dispatch allow; no Stop block
guard_observations.run_C_missing_role: prompt state; collaborationspawn_agent dispatch allow (spawn then failed); no Stop block
guard_observations.note: guard.jsonl has no lines for the subagent's own apply_patch/Bash calls (they matched the registered PreToolUse matcher; no deny/log line was written)

role_started_candidates.spawn_post_response: weak: success is a PostToolUse with tool_response = JSON string {task_name}; failure is NO PostToolUse; neither carries agent_id/agent_type, and the failure text is not visible to hooks
role_started_candidates.subagent_start_event: strongest: SubagentStart carries agent_id + agent_type, session_id equal to main's; it fires only when the role actually started
role_started_candidates.first_event_with_agent_id: also works (subagent PreToolUse carries agent_id + agent_type + main session_id) but a role that edits nothing would never show it
